# ThreadRow

Thread list row (32px lead, title + chips + time, preview line) and ThreadGroup.

`OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.ThreadRow`

## Use

```jsx
<OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.ThreadRow title="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.ThreadRow" title="…"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Thread row (web/src ThreadList.tsx). 18px-radius row with a Bencho hover wash; 32px round lead holding the status dot (or channel avatar + dot badge when `channel` is set); line 1: 14px title, flags/chips, mono time; line 2: harness, branch pill, preview, T-id. Idle rows drop to regular weight in fg-2. Compact density hides line 2. @startingPoint section="Thread" subtitle="Thread list row + day group" viewport="760x320"
